message.text:
I need to identify which memo lifecycle events dispatch webhooks, their dispatch function names, and where all webhook delivery converges.

I'll examine memo_service_webhooks.go to find all webhook dispatch events and their convergence point.

Mapping memo lifecycle events to webhook dispatch functions. The first entry is `memos.memo.created` mapped to `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook`.

`memos.memo.updated` maps to `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook`. `memos.memo.deleted` maps to `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook`. `memos.memo.comment.created` maps to `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook`.

Created, updated, and deleted events converge on `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`, which calls `webhook.PostAsync`. Comment-created events call `webhook.PostAsync` directly. All paths ultimately converge on `webhook.PostAsync` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`, which queues to the `Post` function.

q30.

memos.memo.created: DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook  
memos.memo.updated: DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook  
memos.memo.deleted: DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook  
memos.memo.comment.created: DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook  

webhook.PostAsync — internal/webhook/webhook.go (HTTP delivery via `Post`)

All four dispatch functions are in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`. Create, update, and delete go through `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`, which loads the memo creator’s webhooks and enqueues each payload. Comment-created loads the parent memo owner’s webhooks and enqueues directly.

Every path ends at `webhook.PostAsync` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`, which puts work on a background queue; workers call `Post` to send the signed HTTP POST.
